items.title: Wilbert Tillman Interview, 1961-08-15
items.q: I played with Willie Cornish. I had me and Willie Cornish on trombone. And Octave Crosby on drums. And Sam Toole's on banjo.

ctx.x: Who was with you in the Pellis Band?

Pellis Band, well at that time we had Nyash Ross on bass. And Alan Gordett on trumpet. I was on clarinet. I can't remember who was playing guitar and drums. But I know that was our first little band, you know? About how many pieces were it? We had six. Six pieces. Six pieces, yeah. Then I, after people found out I could play well, then we started splitting up and getting with different bands. I played with Willie Cornish. I had me and Willie Cornish on trombone. And Octave Crosby on drums. And Sam Toole's on…
I've seen the name and the picture of their band.
